1: Input: Given computation error \(\varepsilon\), offloading time \(t_{u,k}^{\mathrm{Ph-IV}}\), secrecy provisioning \(\varsigma_k\).
2: Case 1 to find \(d_{u,k}^{\mathrm{off}}\) and the corresponding \(\hat{E}_{\mathrm{tot-sub}}^{\mathrm{min}}\)
3: Initialization: Initialize \(\alpha = 0\), upper bound \(\beta^{\mathrm{ub}} = \underline{\beta}\), lower bound \(\beta^{\mathrm{lb}} = \overline{\beta}\).
4: while \(\beta^{\mathrm{lb}} < \beta^{\mathrm{ub}}\) do
5: Update bound value of \(\beta^{\mathrm{bv}} = \frac{1}{2} (\beta^{\mathrm{lb}} + \beta^{\mathrm{ub}})\).
6: Compute value of \(d_{u,k}^{\mathrm{off}}\) using (60).
7: if \(\sum_{k \in \mathcal{K}} d_{u,k}^{\mathrm{off}} > D_u^{\mathrm{off}} - \frac{\rho_u (T^{\max} - t_{u}^{\mathrm{Ph-I}} - t_{u}^{\mathrm{Ph-II}})}{\nu_u} + \varepsilon\) then
8: Update the lower bound \(\beta^{\mathrm{lb}} = \beta^{\mathrm{bv}}\).
9: else
10: if \(\sum_{k \in \mathcal{K}} d_{u,k}^{\mathrm{off}} < D_u^{\mathrm{off}} - \frac{\rho_u (T^{\max} - t_{u}^{\mathrm{Ph-I}} - t_{u}^{\mathrm{Ph-II}})}{\nu_u} - \varepsilon\) then
11: Update the upper bound \(\beta^{\mathrm{ub}} = \beta^{\mathrm{bv}}\).
12: else
13: Set \(d_{u,k}^{\mathrm{off} *} = d_{u,k}^{\mathrm{off}}\).
14: Compute value of \(\hat{E}_{\mathrm{tot-sub}}^{\mathrm{min}}\) using \(d_{u,k}^{\mathrm{off} *}\).
15: end if
16: end if
17: end while
18: Output: \(d_{u,k}^{\mathrm{off} *} \text{ and the corresponding } \hat{E}_{\mathrm{tot-sub}}^{\mathrm{min}}\).
19: Case 2 to find \(d_{u,k}^{\mathrm{off}}\) and the corresponding \(\hat{E}_{\mathrm{tot-sub}}^{\mathrm{min}}\)
20: Initialization: Initialize \(\beta = 0\), upper bound \(\alpha^{\mathrm{ub}} = \overline{\alpha}\), lower bound \(\alpha^{\mathrm{lb}} = \underline{\alpha}\).
21: while \(\alpha^{\mathrm{lb}} < \alpha^{\mathrm{ub}}\) do
22: Update bound value of \(\alpha^{\mathrm{bv}} = \frac{1}{2} (\alpha^{\mathrm{lb}} + \alpha^{\mathrm{ub}})\).
23: Compute value of \(d_{u,k}^{\mathrm{off}}\) using (60).
24: if \(\sum_{k \in \mathcal{K}} d_{u,k}^{\mathrm{off}} > D_u^{\mathrm{off}} + \varepsilon\) then
25: Update the upper bound \(\alpha^{\mathrm{ub}} = \alpha^{\mathrm{bv}}\).
26: else
27: if \(\sum_{k \in \mathcal{K}} d_{u,k}^{\mathrm{off}} < D_u^{\mathrm{off}} - \varepsilon\) then
28: Update the lower bound \(\alpha^{\mathrm{lb}} = \alpha^{\mathrm{bv}}\).
29: else
30: Set \(d_{u,k}^{\mathrm{off} *} = d_{u,k}^{\mathrm{off}}\).
31: Compute value of \(\hat{E}_{\mathrm{tot-sub}}^{\mathrm{min}}\) using \(d_{u,k}^{\mathrm{off} *}\).
32: end if
33: end if
34: end while
35: Output: \(d_{u,k}^{\mathrm{off} *} \text{ and the corresponding } \hat{E}_{\mathrm{tot-sub}}^{\mathrm{min}}\).
36: Case 3 to find \(d_{u,k}^{\mathrm{off}}\) and the corresponding \(\hat{E}_{\mathrm{tot-sub}}^{\mathrm{min}}\)
37: Initialization: Initialize \(\alpha = 0, \beta = 0\).
38: Compute value of \(d_{u,k}^{\mathrm{off}}\) using (60).
39: if \(D_u^{\mathrm{tot}} - \frac{\rho_u (T^{\max} - t_{u}^{\mathrm{Ph-I}} - t_{u}^{\mathrm{Ph-II}})}{\nu_u} \leq \sum_{k=1}^{K} d_{u,k}^{\mathrm{off}} \leq D_u^{\mathrm{tot}}\) then
40: Set \(d_{u,k}^{\mathrm{off} *} = d_{u,k}^{\mathrm{off}}\).
41: Compute value of \(\hat{E}_{\mathrm{tot-sub}}^{\mathrm{min}}\) using \(d_{u,k}^{\mathrm{off} *}\).
42: end if
43: Output: \(d_{u,k}^{\mathrm{off} *} \text{ and the corresponding } \hat{E}_{\mathrm{tot-sub}}^{\mathrm{min}}\).

ParametersValues
The fixed height of UAV, H_{k}100m
The channel bandwidth of underwater acoustic transmission, W_{i} [37]1kHz
The channel bandwidth allocated to UAV, W_{u,k}1kHz
The spreading factor, \kappa [36]1.5
The power consumption coefficient, \epsilon_{u}10^{-18}
The path loss exponent, \eta1
The channel power gain associated with a reference distance, \chi10^{-4}
The average eavesdropping-path strength, \mu_{u,E}10^{-8}
The central frequency of acoustic signal, \theta1kHz
The number of CPU cycles for processing one bit of acoustic signal, v_{u}10^{4}cycles
The processing capability of USV in CPU cycles per second, \rho_{u}10^{6}cycles/s
The channel power gain between USV and eavesdropper, h_{u,E}10^{-9}dB
The powers of background noise at eavesdropper, N_{E}10^{-9}dBm
The powers of background noise at USV, N_{u}10^{-9}dBm
The offset radius of USV, C_{u}5m
The offset radius of UAV, C_{k}5m
The maximum computation delay, T^{\max}4s
- FDMA-based Scheme for Underwater Transmission: USNs upload their collected data to USV via FDMA without any interference. The bandwidth of acoustic channel is uniformly distributed to each USNs.

- Heuristic Fixed Computation Offloading: USV can off-load its computation workloads to multi-UAVs with the fixed ratio of 25%, 50% and 75%, and uniformly offload to multi-UAVs and USV for local computing.

- LINGO Global-solver: The LINGO global-solver adopts the classic algorithm to solve the nonconvexity of the optimization problem, which provides the optimal solution for Problem (ECM) as a benchmark.
